periods.name: WATSON真相与第三个男人揭示
periods.summary: Back in Zandra, Titaro-Dado rejuvenates and is revealed as John H. Watson I. The phrase Wonder absolute true strongest overwhelming noggin is revealed as an acronym: WATSON, Sherlock's true treasure and force multiplier.
periods.outcome: Watson agrees to accompany Sherlock against Moriarty; volume ends on the Go For The NEXT reveal.
